CREATE TABLE items_g2 (
    ref_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    ttl TEXT,
    avg_rtg REAL,
    prc INTEGER,
    prc_usd REAL,
    str_nm TEXT,
    main_cat TEXT,
    feat_lst TEXT,
    img_ct INTEGER
)

CREATE TABLE fdbk_g2 (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    item_id TEXT,
    ref_id TEXT,
    uid TEXT,
    rtg REAL,
    ttl TEXT,
    body TEXT,
    ts INTEGER,
    hlp_ct INTEGER,
    vrf TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (ref_id) REFERENCES items_g2(ref_id)
)

sql: SELECT main_cat, COUNT(*) c FROM items_g2 GROUP BY main_cat ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT
 SUM(CASE WHEN prc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) prc_null,
 SUM(CASE WHEN prc_usd IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) usd_null,
 SUM(CASE WHEN prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) prc_only,
 SUM(CASE WHEN prc IS NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) usd_only
FROM items_g2

WITH agg AS (
  SELECT i.ref_id,
         COUNT(*) AS n_rev,
         AVG(f.rtg) AS avg_rtg,
         i.prc,
         i.prc_usd
  FROM items_g2 i
  JOIN fdbk_g2 f ON f.ref_id = i.ref_id
  GROUP BY i.ref_id
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN prc_usd > 50 AND n_rev >= 5 AND avg_rtg < 3.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS using_prc_usd,
  SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(prc_usd, prc/100.0) > 50 AND n_rev >= 5 AND avg_rtg < 3.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS using_coalesce,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prc_usd > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS priced_over_50_items
FROM agg

SELECT i.ref_id, i.ttl, i.prc_usd, COUNT(*) n_rev, ROUND(AVG(f.rtg),3) avg_rtg
FROM items_g2 i JOIN fdbk_g2 f ON f.ref_id = i.ref_id
WHERE i.prc_usd > 50
GROUP BY i.ref_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 AND AVG(f.rtg) < 3.0
ORDER BY avg_rtg
